main_body: Large wooden crate with a smaller crate stacked or placed beside it. Each has a light plank top and a dark brown front face with a diagonal brace.
top_band: Light tan horizontal plank rows, about rows 1-9 on the large crate (tan with a lighter stripe pattern), ending in a dark edge at row 9-10.
evidence: In a column through the large crate, the top is a tall light tan band of plank rows (about rows 1-9). A dark row at about row 9-10 marks the front edge and shades the face. Below it is the darker brown front face (about rows 10-18) with a diagonal brace and a dark frame on the left and top. The small crate repeats the same structure. The top is clearly a horizontal surface seen from above, and the front is a separate vertical face. No receding side face is drawn.

style.evidence: The top has only alternating tan stripes, about 3 tones, with no grain dots or knots. The front face is a large flat dark brown area with a single-tone diagonal brace and little wood grain or per-plank highlights. The dark bottom strip is near-black and tinted purple, while the edges are dark brown, so the outline is mixed. Beodeul's stall and well have 5-6 shading steps and dense texture per tile. This candidate reads thinner and flatter next to them.
